text: Root cause of the ugly board = v1's frame-with-3-bands layout; replaced with compact sectioned node + connected satellites
Killed the floating clusters (root-cause cluster placement), legible edges, captioned bubbles
tsc clean, 13 canvas test files green across all iterations

[status_update] §22/§23 STEP 1 landed (0f72261b): ONE fixed-size SectionedPlanNode merging plan+spec. HEADER (title/owner/coverage + per-node Doc|Card|Tile switch + fit-node) + always-rendered RIGHT-EDGE RAIL (per section: glyph·title·[n]·OUTPUT dot = in-node TOC + stable task anchors) + BODY in FIXED frame per manual mode (Document=full RichMarkdown of section bodies w/ INTERNAL SCROLL; Card=titles+digests; Tile=coverage summary). Spec prose = section bodies (no separate spec node). KILLED auto-by-zoom (mode is manual; zoom=camera only). FIXED bbox per mode: planTileH 280/planCardH 400/planDocH 640, width 480, railW 100. Fixes the 3 live bugs: (1) overflow -> nodeStyle now FIXED height, content scrolls inside frame; (2) plan-as-title-list -> rail+section bodies; (3) milestone text -> Document interior (step cards next, STEP 2). Tasks band off rail OUTPUT dots (§20.3 sweep). intraPlan 164->92. tsc clean, all canvas suites green (added cards/sectionedPlanNode.test.tsx), vite build clean, cargo+clippy pass.

§24 PRIORITY 1 done (7a4d5fd6). §24.1: removed Doc/Card/Tile mode switcher entirely — ONE behavior, every node adapts CONTENT to camera zoom (content-LOD) inside a FIXED frame; toolbar is camera-only. Deleted the manual-mode system (toolbar buttons, per-node mode state, resolveGlobalMode, NodeModeResolver, viewMode.ts). §24.3: UN-MERGED spec from plan (reverts the §22.2 merge) -> new cards/SectionNode.tsx (variant plan|spec) replacing SectionedPlanNode (+ old PlanNode/SpecSectionCard deleted). Three connected columns SPEC | PLAN | tasks: PLAN = one row/section (glyph·title·[n]·OUTPUT dot), SPEC = one block/section (content-LOD: far titles / near full prose w/ internal scroll), 1:1 spec<->plan edges by section id, plan OUTPUT -> banded tasks. Spec+plan share sectionNodeH so rows align. tsc clean, all canvas suites green (rewrote cards/layout/CanvasView/registry tests, deleted per-mode tests), vite clean, cargo+clippy pass. Next: §25 zoom-drill (Priority 2).

§24.1 + §24.3 integrated to feat/canvas (8b110452) and VERIFIED LIVE via Playwright: mode switcher removed (toolbar = camera-only); spec un-merged into separate SPEC node (25 blocks) + PLAN node (25 rows) with 1:1 section-mapping edges, both reflect coverage; 47 task cards, 141 edges, 0 console errors. The two-connected-nodes board the user wanted to SEE. tsc clean, 14 canvas tsx suites green.

ANDREY DIRECTION — unified WORLDS zoom model. Zoom is the ONLY navigation, NOTHING behind clicks. Nested worlds zooming INTO the plan: FAR=plan-as-one-world (mass); CLOSER=structure (spec|plan|tasks distinguishable+connected); CLOSER=content (REAL body text inside plan/spec/task, markdown structured, not just titles); CLOSER=depth (subtask bodies + execution milestone/step text inside tasks).
